briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and DeepSeek-R2 accelerate AGI timelines as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models amid regulatory scrutiny and escalating compute demands. US-China tensions over chip exports remain elevated while safety frameworks lag deployment pace.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with multimodal reasoning gains; xAI launched Grok-4; DeepSeek-R2 achieved competitive performance on coding benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 focuses on constitutional AI refinements.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize agentic system red-teaming.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce joint 100k H100 cluster expansions. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs by end of 2027?
